note: Two consecutive worker runs over the same frames produced byte-identical outcomes (greedy decoding, seed 0). The three extents sample the three declared flat-colour shots; the model described them as a solid red, a solid green, and a deep blue screen. That is a proposal about these frames under this recipe, not ground truth about anything. Ordinary CI replays this outcome; the live court runs the worker only when media/worker-vlm/.venv and the verified weights already exist and never installs or downloads either.
